name: Whisparr
summary: Open-source self-hosted adult movie/scene metadata organizer modeled cleanly on Sonarr/Radarr and integrated natively with ThePornDB.
ranking_rationale: Automates local library metadata tagging, studio sorting & performer cataloging cleanly (trade-off: assumes technical familiarity with self-hosted Servarr tooling).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Automates local library metadata tagging, studio sorting & performer cataloging cleanly
100% open-source, self-hosted & private across Docker, Windows, and Linux
Seamless API integration with ThePornDB and Stash
cons: Assumes technical familiarity with self-hosted Servarr tooling
Separate companion tools needed for playback
